card.title: POLIKARPOV PO-2
card.flavorText: The Polikarpov Po-2 was a Soviet biplane produced from 1928 to 1952, and was one of the most produced aircraft in history, with as many as 30,000 built. The Po-2 served many roles in WWII, as a reconnaissance aircraft, light and short range bomber, night ground attack aircraft, transportation and military liaison aircraft, and from the beginning it was used as a civil and military trainer. A variant was also used as an agricultural aircraft, which earned it its nickname Kukuruznik (Russian for "crop duster"). German troops nicknamed it Nähmaschine (German for “sewing machine”) because of its rattling sound.
